title: Top 3 Telegram Bulk Account Creators for Affiliates in 2026
description: Top Telegram bulk account creators compared: ONE DASH, Telegram Expert, TG-GIANT. Use cases, features, account lifespan, and pricing included.

Contents What Are Telegram Bulk Account Creators and How Do They Work Why Telegram Bulk Account Creators Are Used How Long Do Such Accounts Live Top 3 Platforms for Bulk Account Creation ONE DASH Telegram Expert TG-GIANT How to Choose the Right Software Conclusion What Are Telegram Bulk Account Creators and How Do They Work This is a specialized tool that automates the creation of Telegram profiles. The process typically works as follows: It collects proxies and phone numbers for SMS verification. These can be uploaded manually or provided by the affiliate. During registration, the messenger sends an SMS verification code. The software intercepts this request and inputs the code into the required field. The account is then completed with a profile picture, name, bio, status, etc. Finally, the login credentials and other account details are saved into a separate file for easy access. As a result, the affiliate receives a batch of fresh accounts ready for use. But these profiles should be warmed up over the course of 3-5 days before launching campaigns. This involves joining channels, reacting to posts, leaving comments, and mimicking regular user activity. Otherwise, the messenger may flag the account as fraudulent, since the platform prohibits the use of third-party tools for automated account creation. Why Telegram Bulk Account Creators Are Used Such creators are primarily useful for affiliates running advertising campaigns on Telegram. Experienced affiliates highlight at least three use cases: Mass messaging : Typically, you can send up to 30 messages with links and 50 without . If users report the messages as spam, the platform may impose a soft ban (3-7 days), where you can only message people in your contact list. Repeated violations can lead to permanent bans. With a batch of accounts, you can send 25 messages from one profile, switch to the next, and continue the campaign. Simplifying campaign structure : Without Telegram Premium, a user can create only 10 folder groups for organizing channels. This is often not enough for testing multiple verticals. With automatically registered accounts, you can create 10 accounts per niche, giving you clear segmentation and avoiding confusion. Saving time : If you have fast internet and access to real or virtual numbers, manual account creation takes about 4-6 minutes. A bulk account creator, on the other hand, can generate 20-30 profiles in that same timeframe — with no manual input required. In short, they optimize the process of preparing Telegram accounts for marketing and allow affiliates to focus on higher-priority tasks. This topic is closely related to another one dedicated to accounts creation but for Reddit . Check it out! How Long Do Such Accounts Live The lifespan of profiles depends on several factors. Proxy and type of phone number. In practice, the combination of a virtual number and a proxy gives the longest lifespan. On average, it’s about 35 days with active use. Accounts registered to a physical number live up to two weeks but are easier to recover if blocked. When choosing a proxy , it’s best to use one located in the same region as the number. User behavior. If you automatically create an account, change the avatar, name, and bio within five minutes, and then start spamming unknown users, the profile won’t last a day. Here’s what the platform’s support says about spam blocks. As for private messages, it actually doesn’t matter what you’re sending if recipients consider it unwanted. It could be a photo, an invite link, or just a simple “hi.” Please only send messages when you are sure people will not object to receiving them. As a rule, people do not mind receiving unsolicited ads, links, invite links to groups or channels, random photos, and above all, anything related to commerce or internet popularity . If you send them something like that, you will be blocked — and everyone else will be happy. Moderators are more lenient when it comes to group messages, but anyone who sends spam or unsolicited ads will be restricted. Therefore, after registration, it’s recommended to let the account rest for 5-7 days, start a few dialogues and group chats, subscribe to channels, and add 2-3 friends. Otherwise, the messenger will detect that the profile was created using third-party software and issue a ban. 3. GEO. Experienced buyers note that accounts created with phone numbers from Russia, the USA, and CIS countries such as Belarus, Armenia, Azerbaijan, and Georgia tend to live the longest. To extend the lifespan of the profile, you need to behave like a real person. This way, you can run traffic from one account for three months, six months, or even longer. Top 3 Platforms for Bulk Account Creation We’ve selected three services suitable for affiliates of different levels. The first is for professionals, the last is good for beginners. What you can expect from each tool is described below. ONE DASH Website: https://tg-onedash.com/ Price: the team offers a single plan with the most affordable pricing. To test the service for a week, you only need to pay $7.9. The reason for the low price is obvious: the platform’s functionality isn’t as impressive as that of its competitors. Another explanation is that ONE DASH was originally designed for automating promotion and growth within the messenger, not solely for auto-registering profiles. Additional services include a personal manager for $40 (prices may vary) per month. They will guide you on how to use the platform and provide advice on working within your specific niche. Telegram Expert Website: https://en.telegramexpert.pro Pricing : There is only one plan, but the price depends on the subscription period. A trial is also available. The features of the basic Telegram Expert package are as follows. The developers offer additional services for an extra fee. Experienced affiliates can get the maximum package by participating in the affiliate program. For example, for 35 leads who purchase a one-year subscription, you can get free access to the full package for three years plus a couple of thousand USD. TG-GIANT Website: https://tg-giant.com Pricing: The service offers five subscription options. The cost depends on the included features. For example, the “Centurion” plan costs $94 per month. They also offer a two-day trial to test all features. TG-GIANT is capable of warming up accounts, inviting users to groups, removing spam blocks, and copying messages from one chat to another. Additionally, it can even freeze someone else’s profile by sending multiple complaints. The developers constantly improve their product, ensuring users always have a fresh and up-to-date tool at their disposal. How to Choose the Right Software To choose the right solution without making a mistake, you need to consider three factors: Functionality. If an affiliate is just starting to work with Telegram, it makes sense to purchase a subscription to ONE DASH. The service offers the minimum set of basic functions necessary for work. More advanced specialists can test the other two tools from our selection. They are more expensive, but also offer more additional features. Resources. Some software solutions use their own phone numbers and proxies for account creation, while others require you to upload them manually. Therefore, you need to check how the selected service works. Otherwise, the buyer risks paying for a cheap product, purchasing resources separately, and ending up spending more than if they had bought a more expensive subscription from a competitor. Additional services. Experienced affiliates think ahead, so it’s important to try to predict which features might be needed in the future. For example, if an affiliate needs a message cloner to automate mailings, and it’s not even available among paid features, they’ll have to test another product and get used to a new interface again. Conclusion Telegram bulk account creators do save time and money when preparing accounts for work. But before paying for a tool, it’s a good idea to talk to other affiliates who have already used similar software. This helps reduce the time spent on searching for and testing a suitable solution. There’s an alternative way to get accounts — buying them. However, in this case, you’ll have to carefully select the supplier to avoid logs or brute-forced accounts. These profiles tend to live longer since they belong to real users, but using them comes at your own risk: stealing personal data can lead to criminal liability.
